rules.title: Untrusted input interpolated into a script
rules.why: ${{ github.event.issue.title }} (and similar) is pasted into the shell script before it runs, so a crafted title runs commands.
rules.fix: Assign it to an env variable and use "$VAR" in the script.

rules.title: Privileged workflow checks out pull request code
rules.why: pull_request_target runs with secrets and write access; checking out the PR head runs untrusted code with them.
rules.fix: Use pull_request, or do not run PR code in this workflow.

rules.title: Workflow grants write-all permissions
rules.why: write-all gives the job token every write scope.
rules.fix: List only the permissions the job needs.

rules.title: Third-party action not pinned to a commit
rules.why: A tag can be moved to malicious code; only a commit SHA is immutable.
rules.fix: Pin to a full commit SHA and let Dependabot update it.
